name: ratewatch
description: One toast when a usage window (5-hour or weekly) passes 80%, with the sessions that spent the most

percent.title: Warn at (percent)
percent.description: Toast once per window when its usage passes this. Between 10 and 100.

share.title: Name the sessions that spent the most
share.description: Each session writes its repo name and cost so far to a small file in the shared folder, so the toast can say which sessions spent the most. Off: the toast only says this session's cost.

dir.title: Shared folder
dir.description: Where those files go. Empty means ~/.claude/ratewatch. Sessions that use the same folder see each other.
